reason: A DSH interface plugin that adds a right-side workspace for background side conversations, subagent and goal views, pinned per-session notes, status notifications, and sidebar controls.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH 添加右侧工作区，用于管理后台旁支对话、子代理和目标，并编辑每个会话的置顶笔记。
summaries.en: Adds a DSH right-side workspace for managing background side conversations, subagents, goals, and editable pinned notes per session.

capabilities: Creates and manages background side-conversation sessions
Forks conversation context into child sessions
Displays side conversations, subagents, and goals in an integrated workspace
Persists and edits per-session pinned notes
Writes board data to a local JSON file and exposes same-origin board routes
Generates status notifications for side-conversation completion or failure
